mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever the rate is low, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% over the past 5 trading days indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 20 days signal robust consumer demand, which accelerates economic growth and lifts equity prices, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: when HOUST and RSAFS both rise, SPX returns are not positive in 60% of cases, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with INDPRO rising.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 0) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of months when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM) and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS within 0.05% of target) signals a central bank maintaining accommodative policy amid inflation, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails: when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable, SPX returns are negative in 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 1000 thousand units), strong housing activity drives consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) over the past 60 days signals a manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when INDPRO < 100.
